arguments.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Image 1 is the ACTUAL retreat scene to edit. Image 2 is a same-size ORIGINAL CODE-NATIVE COORDINATE PAINT-ZONE GUIDE, not a new composition and not a pixel-accurate mask. Image 3 is the selected graphic-novel character reference for broad ink/matte rendering only. Use NO other rendering model. Make ONE literal OPAQUE REGIONAL SURFACE REPAINT.

In the grey-green STONE regions indicated by image 2, paint opaque new quiet slate/grey/ochre wash shapes over the old decorative marks. Each large stone/paving area uses TWO OR THREE LARGE MATTE VALUE PLANES. ERASE the old rock mottles, little speckled grains and carpet of leaf-litter flecks by replacing them with these larger coherent painted shapes. Preserve the actual existing major stone silhouettes, steps, joints and support edges; draw only a few selective structural contours, not hundreds of tiny cracks. The ground remains the SAME wet stone paving at the same perspective, without new construction. Small foreground reflected marks may be slightly less saturated, while the important blue threshold remains untouched.

In the TEAL WATER areas of the guide, repaint the old uniform field of tiny white reflection strokes into broad connected muted slate-water planes with just a FEW long broken quiet reflections. Keep the actual water surface, threshold and character/foot contacts at the same coordinates. No new depth or flood level. Keep the source creatures' existing wet lower contact conditions.

In the DARK GREEN secondary ROOTS/VEGETATION areas, group incidental internal root ridges, leaves and dry litter into larger quiet matte silhouettes. Preserve the same large roots, trunks and ruined-wall structure; erase the little equally bright flecks and fine decorative internal mesh. Keep selective outer contours and a few essential load-bearing edges. The original atmospheric distance and pale background silhouettes remain coherent.

The CREAM/RED outlined shapes in image 2 are PROTECTED SOURCE REGIONS, approximate coordinate advice only: all living/creature figures, boughs, tools, ward and boot/contact zones. Retain every actual pixel relationship in those subjects rather than drawing the cream silhouettes. Protect the source TWO humans, ONE living three-head hydra and TWO active guards; same poses, faces, clothing seams and material colors. Preserve exactly TWO INDEPENDENT boughs: the first already grounded along the low foreground, the second thicker bough held by M's two hands with far end resting on ground. Keep their separate continuous trunks, distinct cut endpoints and grounded supports. M's whole shield stays on his back with real strap; sword stays sheathed at anatomical LEFT hip. Both M palms/grips unchanged. Zoya's RIGHT hand keeps the ONE continuous iron prybar with the same bent flattened unforked foot; her LEFT hand remains empty and separate, same wrist/fingers. TWO unused oak wedges stay in her ONE apron pocket. Keep all human boot positions and local damp leather/cloth/skin conditions.

Preserve the ONE raised intact gate slab, guides, overhead connected chain, right winch, left root geography, camera and crop. Preserve the real dull bronze threshold with its necessary local BLUE sheen and the original unlit RIGHT gap; no new glowing shapes. All physical contacts and current source branch conditions stay intact.

This is replacement of environmental surface mark-making in the specified regions, NOT blur, sharpening, a dark filter or a whole-frame reconstruction. The broad new opaque paint planes must be clearly simpler than the source surfaces at reader scale, with the unchanged people/props reading first. Keep serious restrained folklore graphic-novel ink and matte washes, not photography. Output only the full opaque 1672x941 edited illustration; no guide colors, dashed lines, labels, border, text or UI.
